stages.name: First Watch
stages.text: The first refugees are on the road. Hold the pass against grunts and fast runners; road heroes block them, platform heroes shoot from above.

stages.name: The Green Road
stages.text: Flyers arrive: they soar over your blockers and only platform heroes can hit them. Keep at least two heroes on the platforms.

stages.name: Iron Hides
stages.text: Brutes shrug off physical hits, so bring magic damage. Menders heal everyone around them; take them out first.

stages.name: Shield Wall
stages.text: Shieldbearers carry a shield that regrows if you stop hitting them, and archers shoot your blockers from range. Many quick hits break shields fastest.

stages.name: The Horned Warden
stages.text: Baphomet guards the end of the pass. It silences the hero that hit it last and hardens its hide from time to time; spread your damage over several heroes.

stages.name: Hexfire
stages.text: Hexers resist magic and hex the nearest hero so it briefly cannot attack. Archers outrange the hex and physical damage cuts them down fastest.

stages.name: Two Gates
stages.text: The ruins have two gates and every group of enemies splits between them. Spread your squad so neither lane is left open.

stages.name: Brood Hollow
stages.text: Broodcallers resist magic and keep calling imps while they walk. Snipe the callers with archers before the swarm grows.

stages.name: Eve of the Crossing
stages.text: Every enemy you have met comes at once, through both gates. A long stage tests your whole squad; level your heroes if you fall short.

stages.name: The Crossing
stages.text: Lilith waits at the crossing and cannot be hit while her children stand; every blow to them also hurts her. The chapter's final battle.

stages.name: The Dry Basin
stages.text: A new road winds through the basin and doubles back on itself. The platforms in its heart see three stretches of road at once; claim them early.

stages.name: Glass Sands
stages.text: Archers dig in on the dunes and shoot at your platforms; shieldbearers cover their advance. Blockers on the road draw their fire.

stages.name: Serpent Wells
stages.text: Menders tend the brutes at the old wells while hexers curse your heroes. Break the healers first. Stheno waits at the last well.

stages.name: Brood of Noon
stages.text: Broodcallers hatch swarms in the heat. Kill them before they reach the long bends, or the brood floods the basin.

stages.name: Mirage Gate
stages.text: Everything the desert has, and the sky full of wings. Keep platform heroes spread along the whole road.

stages.name: Throne of Ash
stages.text: The Horned Warden returns to the basin with the whole desert at his back. Hold the Sanctuary and Helios will stand with you.

stages.name: Beneath the Canopy
stages.text: The Sunscar road vanishes beneath the canopy. Secure the tight switchbacks before runners and shieldbearers take the inner court.

stages.name: The Root Maze
stages.text: Ancient roots split the road into overlapping kill zones. Hold the central turns while archers and hexers attack from behind the advance.

stages.name: Flooded Court
stages.text: The temple court channels every assault through a shallow basin. Break the menders before the brutes climb back out. Hecate guards the far stair.

stages.name: Jaguar Steps
stages.text: The short climb to the jaguar shrine leaves little time to recover. Spread damage across the bends and stop each brood before it multiplies.

stages.name: Emerald Coil
stages.text: The longest road coils around the inner ruins. Layer your defenses: every enemy in the jungle joins the march to the Heart Temple.

stages.name: Heart of the Jungle
stages.text: Ochenta, the Proud Commander, marches on the Heart Temple with the whole jungle host behind him. Every blow you land feeds his Valor: hit hard, not often, and keep the jade heart alive.
